Every villanelle has nineteen lines..why: The definition of the form, stated in its Wikipedia lead and hundreds of times in Dolma beside the word villanelle. No real exception: the fixed form is nineteen lines (five tercets and a quatrain); older songs called villanelles before the form was fixed had no form at all, and a poem of another length is not called a villanelle.
